name: image-alt-field
title: Image alt text field
description: Upload an image and describe it in the same place: a preview, an alt text box with live advice, and a decorative checkbox that is a deliberate choice.
docs: src is an image that already exists; a file the person chooses is previewed from the file itself and wins over it. value and onValueChange report { file, alt, decorative }, and defaultValue starts it when you do not control it. The decorative checkbox empties the description and switches the box off, and unchecking it brings the old text back, so decorative is a decision and not a field that was forgotten. The advice line under the box follows the text: empty, starting with image of or photo of, looking like a file name, very short, near maxLength, and fine. maxLength (125) limits the text and is counted. invalid shows a missing description as an error, and with required a missing image too; required also keeps a form from submitting without an image, and then the error shows and focus goes to Choose an image. accept and maxSize are checked before a file is taken, and name puts the file, the description (nameAlt) and the mark (nameDecorative) in the form. labels carries every word.
